name: Windham Academy Summer Camp
description_short: A four-week summer camp for ages 4–13, run by Windham Academy, a public charter school in Windham, NH. Families can sign up by the week, and a paid extended hour from 3 to 4 PM is offered.
refund_policy_summary: Registration fee (one-time, per child) is non-refundable and does not count toward tuition. Tuition is refundable, minus the registration fee, only if you cancel before May 1; after that it is non-refundable. No refunds or credits for missed days or weeks. Full payment is due by June 1.
special_needs_notes: Campers must be potty trained. Four-year-olds must turn 4 by January 31, 2026.

Price details: $375 per week is the regular rate. Families who registered by March 1 paid $350 per week, each additional sibling gets $25 off per week, and extended hours cost $100 per week extra. A required non-refundable registration fee is charged per child, but the amount is not shown.
